```{r}
  x[, col_sd > 0, drop = FALSE]
```

### 2.2 Coherence Filtering

```{r}
coherence_thresholds <- c(0.55, 0.60, 0.70)

for (t in coherence_thresholds) {
  
  n_keep <- sum(cadia_tsf_only$coherence >= t)
  pct_keep <- mean(cadia_tsf_only$coherence >= t) * 100
  
  cat(
    "Threshold:", t,
    "- Points:", n_keep,
    "- Percent:", round(pct_keep, 1), "%\n"
  )
}
```

Choosing 0.70 as Rana et al. did.

**Setup:**

```{r}
cadia_coherence_threshold <- 0.70
```

## 3. Sliding Window Temporal Clustering Workflow

### 3.1 Median Cumulative Displacement Version

```{r}
# filtered cadia dataset including 0 baseline
cadia_D_filtered_sliding <- cadia_D_filtered
```

```{r}
dim(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
```

#### 3.1.1 K = 2

```{r}
# temporal clustering setup
# sliding window size 3

set.seed(1234)

k <- 2
window_size <- 3
threshold <- -3

n_pts_filtered <- nrow(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

# number of overlapping sliding windows
n_iters_filtered <- n_dates_filtered - window_size + 1

# final date represents each window
iter_dates_filtered <- colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)[
  window_size:n_dates_filtered
]
```

```{r}
# raw K-means membership
cluster_membership_mat_sliding_k2 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_membership_mat_sliding_k2) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)


# fixed-threshold status
cluster_status_mat_sliding_k2 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_status_mat_sliding_k2) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)


# ordered cluster medians
cluster_medians_mat_sliding_k2 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters_filtered,
  ncol = k
)

colnames(cluster_medians_mat_sliding_k2) <- c(
  "Lower median",
  "Higher median"
)


# silhouette score for each window
silhouette_disp_k2_w3 <- numeric(n_iters_filtered)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # extract current 3-date window
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # reset each point to 0 at beginning of window
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  # K-means
  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  # current iteration
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # save raw K-means membership
  cluster_membership_mat_sliding_k2[
    , iter
  ] <- km$cluster
  
  # newest displacement within window
  latest_disp <- x[, ncol(x)]
  
  # median newest displacement of each raw cluster
  cluster_medians <- tapply(
    latest_disp,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # sort only for interpretation/plotting
  cluster_medians_mat_sliding_k2[
    iter,
  ] <- sort(cluster_medians)
  
  # fixed threshold classification
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_medians <= threshold,
    1,
    0
  )
  
  # each point inherits status of its raw cluster
  pt_status <- cluster_status[
    as.character(km$cluster)
  ]
  
  cluster_status_mat_sliding_k2[
    , iter
  ] <- pt_status
  
  # silhouette score
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
    km$cluster,
    dist(x)
  )
  
  silhouette_disp_k2_w3[iter] <- mean(
    sil[, "sil_width"]
  )
}
```

```{r}
dim(cluster_medians_mat_sliding_k2)

table(

)
```

```{r}
plot(

```
```{r}

  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered),
  format = "%Y%m%d"
)

cadia_disp_w3_k2_pct <-
  colMeans(cluster_status_mat_sliding_k2 == 1) * 100

png(
  "../outputs/cadia_sw_km2_disp_w3_threshold_pts.png",
  width = 2400,

plot(
```

#### 3.1.2 K = 3

```{r}
# temporal clustering setup
# sliding window size 3 instead of expanding by 1

set.seed(1234)

k <- 3
window_size <- 3
threshold_1 <- -3
threshold_2 <- -5

n_pts_filtered <- nrow(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

# number of overlapping sliding windows
n_iters_filtered <- n_dates_filtered - window_size + 1

# date representing each window = final date in window
iter_dates_filtered <- colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)[
  window_size:n_dates_filtered
]
```

```{r}
# membership matrix
cluster_membership_mat_sliding_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_membership_mat_sliding_k3) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)
```

```{r}
# status matrix
cluster_status_mat_sliding_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_status_mat_sliding_k3) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)
```

```{r}
# medians matrix
cluster_medians_mat_sliding_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters_filtered,
  ncol = k
)

colnames(cluster_medians_mat_sliding_k3) <- c(
  "Lower median",
  "Middle median",
  "Higher median"
)
```

```{r}
silhouette_disp_k3_w3 <- numeric(n_iters_filtered)
```

```{r}
n_iters_filtered
ncol(cluster_membership_mat_sliding_k2)
length(iter_dates_filtered)
```

```{r}
# temporal clustering loop

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # reset each pt to 0 at the start of each window
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  # displacement at newest date
  latest_disp <- x[, ncol(x)]
  
  # current iteration number
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
  km$cluster,
  dist(x)
  )
  
  silhouette_disp_k3_w3[iter] <- mean(
    sil[, "sil_width"]
  )
  
  # store raw cluster membership
  cluster_membership_mat_sliding_k3[
    , iter
  ] <- km$cluster
  
  # median newest displacement
  # for each raw cluster
  cluster_medians <- tapply(
    latest_disp,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # ordered medians only for plotting
  ordered_medians <- sort(
    cluster_medians
  )
  
  cluster_medians_mat_sliding_k3[
    iter,
  ] <- ordered_medians
  
  # classify each raw K-means cluster
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_medians <= threshold_2,
    2,
    ifelse(
      cluster_medians <= threshold_1,
      1,
      0
    )
  )
  
  # each point inherits the status of its cluster
  pt_status <- cluster_status[
    as.character(km$cluster)
  ]
  
  cluster_status_mat_sliding_k3[
    , iter
  ] <- pt_status
  
}
```

### 3.2 Median Velocity Version

#### 3.2.1 K = 2

```{r}
# setup
set.seed(1234)

k <- 2
window_size <- 3
velocity_threshold <- -25

n_pts_filtered <- nrow(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

n_iters_filtered <-
  n_dates_filtered - window_size + 1

iter_dates_filtered <-
  colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)[
    window_size:n_dates_filtered
  ]
```

```{r}
cadia_all_dates <- as.Date(
  sub("^D_", "", colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)),
  format = "%Y%m%d"
)
```

```{r}
head(cadia_all_dates)
diff(cadia_all_dates)
```

```{r}
# membership matrix
cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k2 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k2) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)
```

```{r}
cluster_status_mat_velocity_k2 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_status_mat_velocity_k2) <-
  colnames(cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k2)
```

```{r}
# median matrix
cluster_velocity_mat_k2 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters_filtered,
  ncol = k
)

colnames(cluster_velocity_mat_k2) <- c(
  "Lower velocity",
  "Higher velocity"
)
```

```{r}
silhouette_vel_k2_w3_old <- numeric(n_iters_filtered)
```

```{r}
# temporal clustering loop - velocity version

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # current 3-date displacement window
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # reset each point to 0 at start of window
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  # dates in current window
  window_dates <- cadia_all_dates[start_idx:i]
  
  # time from start of window in days
  time_days <- as.numeric(
    window_dates - window_dates[1]
  )
  
  # K-means on displacement trajectories
  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  # iteration number
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
  km$cluster,
  dist(x)
  )
  
  silhouette_vel_k2_w3_old[iter] <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
  
  # store raw cluster membership
  cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k2[
    , iter
  ] <- km$cluster
  
  # velocity for each individual point
  point_velocity <- apply(
    x,
    1,
    function(y) {
      coef(lm(y ~ time_days))[2]
    }
  )
  
  # mm/day -> mm/year
  point_velocity <- point_velocity * 365.25
  
  # median velocity for each raw K-means cluster
  cluster_velocities <- tapply(
    point_velocity,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # ordered values just for plotting/inspection
  ordered_velocities <- sort(
    cluster_velocities
  )
  
  cluster_velocity_mat_k2[
    iter,
  ] <- ordered_velocities
  
  # classify each K-means cluster using fixed velocity threshold
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_velocities <= velocity_threshold,
    1,   # concerning negative velocity
    0    # non-concerning
  )
  
  # every point inherits the status of its K-means cluster
  pt_status <- cluster_status[
    as.character(km$cluster)
  ]
  
  # store point status
  cluster_status_mat_velocity_k2[
    , iter
  ] <- pt_status
}
```

#### 3.2.2 K = 3

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

k <- 3
window_size <- 3
threshold_1 <- -25
threshold_2 <- -75

n_pts_filtered <- nrow(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

n_iters_filtered <-
  n_dates_filtered - window_size + 1

iter_dates_filtered <-
  colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)[
    window_size:n_dates_filtered
  ]

cadia_all_dates <- as.Date(
  sub("^D_", "", colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)),
  format = "%Y%m%d"
)
```

```{r}
cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k3) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)
```

```{r}
cluster_status_mat_velocity_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_status_mat_velocity_k3) <-
  colnames(cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k3)
```

```{r}
cluster_velocity_mat_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters_filtered,
  ncol = k
)

colnames(cluster_velocity_mat_k3) <- c(
  "Lower velocity",
  "Middle velocity",
  "Higher velocity"
)
```

```{r}
silhouette_vel_k3_w3_old <- numeric(n_iters_filtered)
```

```{r}
for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # extract current 3-date window
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # reset each point to 0 at start of window
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  # dates for current window
  window_dates <- cadia_all_dates[start_idx:i]
  
  # time in days from start of window
  time_days <- as.numeric(
    window_dates - window_dates[1]
  )
  
  # K-means on rebased displacement
  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
    km$cluster,
    dist(x)
  )
  
  silhouette_vel_k3_w3_old[iter] <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"])  
  
  # store RAW K-means membership
  cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k3[
    , iter
  ] <- km$cluster
  
  # velocity of each individual point
  point_velocity <- apply(
    x,
    1,
    function(y) {
      coef(lm(y ~ time_days))[2]
    }
  )
  
  # mm/day -> mm/year
  point_velocity <- point_velocity * 365.25
  
  # median velocity of each raw K-means cluster
  cluster_velocities <- tapply(
    point_velocity,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # sort ONLY for inspection
  ordered_velocities <- sort(
    cluster_velocities
  )
  
  cluster_velocity_mat_k3[
    iter,
  ] <- ordered_velocities
  
  # classify raw clusters by median velocity
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_velocities <= threshold_2,
    2,
    ifelse(
      cluster_velocities <= threshold_1,
      1,
      0
    )
  )
  
  # each point inherits its cluster's status
  pt_status <- cluster_status[
    as.character(km$cluster)
  ]

cluster_status_mat_velocity_k3[
  , iter
] <- pt_status
}
```

## 4. DBSCAN Sliding Window (w = 3) Temporal Clustering

Same concept / approach as K-means, but with DBSCAN. This means we have to tune the hyperparameters instead.

```{r}
# setup
library(dbscan)

window_size <- 3

n_pts_filtered <- nrow(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

n_iters_filtered <-
  n_dates_filtered - window_size + 1

iter_dates_filtered <-
  colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)[
    window_size:n_dates_filtered
  ]
```

```{r}
# cluster membership matrix
dbscan_membership_mat <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(dbscan_membership_mat) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)
```

```{r}
# noise matrix
dbscan_noise_mat <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(dbscan_noise_mat) <-
  colnames(dbscan_membership_mat)
```

We will test the process on one temporal window first.

```{r}
# initial test HP: minPts
minPts <- 5
```

We use minPts = 5 as a test. This aligns with the common rule to choose the minPts value in relation to dimensionality, often around double the number of dimensions as a starting point.

```{r}
# initial test HP: eps
x_test <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
  , 1:3,
  drop = FALSE
]

x_test <- sweep(
  x_test,
  1,
  x_test[, 1],
  FUN = "-"
)
```

```{r}
x_test_db <- x_test[, -1, drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
kNNdistplot(
  x_test_db,
  k = minPts
)
abline(h = 1, col = "red")
```

The k-NN plot suggests an eps value of approximately 1 to be appropriate (for an initial test).\

```{r}
eps <- 1.2
```

```{r}
# test w/ 1 window
db_test <- dbscan(
  x_test_db,
  eps = 1,
  minPts = 5
)

table(db_test$cluster)
```

```{r}
mean(db_test$cluster == 0)
```

The initial test seems fairly reasonable, however almost all the points fall into one cluster. There is 7.5% of noise present out of the points in each 3-date displacement windows.

### 4.1 Displacement Version: Temporal Clustering Loop

```{r}
# full loop
  # minPts = 5
  # eps = 1.2 v2

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # current 3-date sliding window
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # reset each pt to 0 at start of window
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  # remove first col cause its all 0 now
  x_db <- x[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  
  db <- dbscan(
    x_db,
    eps = eps,
    minPts = minPts
  )
  
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # raw DBSCAN cluster
  dbscan_membership_mat[, iter] <-
    db$cluster
  
  # 1 = noise/anomaly candidate
  # 0 = belongs to a DBSCAN cluster
  dbscan_noise_mat[, iter] <-
    as.integer(db$cluster == 0)
}
```

#### 4.1.1 Testing other hyperparameters (eps, minPts):

```{r}
eps_values <- c(0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 1.5)
minPts_values <- c(5, 10)
```

```{r}
# wrapped loop to test
dbscan_tuning <- data.frame()

for (eps_val in eps_values) {
  
  for (minPts_val in minPts_values) {
    
    noise_mat_temp <- matrix(
      NA,
      nrow = n_pts_filtered,
      ncol = n_iters_filtered
    )
    
    for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
      
      start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
      
      x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
        , start_idx:i,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
      
      # rebase window
      x <- sweep(
        x,
        1,
        x[, 1],
        FUN = "-"
      )
      
      db <- dbscan(
        x,
        eps = eps_val,
        minPts = minPts_val
      )
      
      iter <- i - window_size + 1
      
      # 1 = noise, 0 = clustered
      noise_mat_temp[, iter] <- as.integer(db$cluster == 0)
    }
    
    noise_per_iter_temp <- colSums(noise_mat_temp)
    
    dbscan_tuning <- rbind(
      dbscan_tuning,
      data.frame(
        eps = eps_val,
        minPts = minPts_val,
        Iteration = 1:n_iters_filtered,
        Date = iter_dates_filtered,
        NoisePoints = noise_per_iter_temp
      )
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
# plot comparison
ggplot(
  dbscan_tuning,
  aes(
    x = Iteration,
    y = NoisePoints,
    group = interaction(eps, minPts),
    linetype = factor(minPts)
  )
) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ eps) +
  labs(
    x = "Sliding window iteration",
    y = "Number of DBSCAN noise points",
    linetype = "minPts"
  )
```

```{r}
# summary stats
dbscan_tuning_summary <- dbscan_tuning %>%
  group_by(eps, minPts) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanNoise = mean(NoisePoints),
    MedianNoise = median(NoisePoints),
    MaxNoise = max(NoisePoints),
    FinalNoise = last(NoisePoints),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dbscan_tuning_summary
```

- The plot shows that changing minPts from 5 to 10 mostly increases the noise across every eps value.

## 5. Sliding Window w/ 5 Acquisitions

Instead of 3.

### 5.1 Median Cumulative Displacement

#### 5.1.1 K = 2

```{r}
# temporal clustering setup
# sliding window size 5 instead of expanding by 1

set.seed(1234)

k <- 2
window_size <- 5
threshold_w5 <- -4 # change after checking

n_pts_filtered <- nrow(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

# number of overlapping sliding windows
n_iters_filtered <- n_dates_filtered - window_size + 1

# date representing each window = final date in window
iter_dates_filtered <- colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)[
  window_size:n_dates_filtered
]
```

```{r}
# matrices

cluster_membership_mat_w5 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

status_mat_w5 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

medians_mat_w5 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters_filtered,
  ncol = k
)

# silhoutte score for later
silhouette_w5 <- numeric(n_iters_filtered)

colnames(cluster_membership_mat_w5) <-
  paste0(
    "cluster_",
    sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
  )

colnames(status_mat_w5) <-
  paste0(
    "cluster_",
    sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
  )

colnames(medians_mat_w5) <- c(
  "Lower_Cluster",
  "Higher_Cluster"
)
```

```{r}
# check
n_iters_filtered
ncol(cluster_membership_mat_w5)
length(iter_dates_filtered)
```

```{r}
# temporal clustering loop
# w = 5 version
set.seed(1234)

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # Extract window
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Rebase first observation to zero
  x <- sweep(x, 1, x[, 1], FUN = "-")
  
  # K-means
  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = 2,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
  km$cluster,
  dist(x)
  )
  
  silhouette_w5[iter] <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
  
  cluster_membership_mat_w5[, iter] <- km$cluster
  
  # Displacement at end of window
  latest_disp <- x[, ncol(x)]
  
  # Median for each raw K-means cluster
  cluster_medians <- tapply(
    latest_disp,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # Sorted ONLY for plotting
  medians_mat_w5[iter, ] <- sort(cluster_medians)
  
  # Apply fixed threshold
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_medians <= threshold_w5,
    1,
    0
  )
  
  # Give every point its cluster's status
  status_mat_w5[, iter] <-
    cluster_status[km$cluster]
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(1234)
```

### 5.2 Median Velocity version

#### 5.2.1 K = 2

```{r}
window_size <- 5
k <- 2

n_pts_filtered <- nrow(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

n_iters_vel_w5 <- n_dates_filtered - window_size + 1

iter_dates_vel_w5 <-
  colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)[
    window_size:n_dates_filtered
  ]

cadia_all_dates <- as.Date(
  sub(
    "^D_",
    "",
    colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
  ),
  format = "%Y%m%d"
)
```

```{r}
cluster_membership_vel_w5 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_vel_w5
)

status_vel_w5 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_vel_w5
)

vel_medians_w5 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters_vel_w5,
  ncol = 2
)

silhouette_vel_w5_old <- numeric(n_iters_vel_w5)

colnames(vel_medians_w5) <-
  c("Lower_Cluster", "Higher_Cluster")

date_names_vel_w5 <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_vel_w5)
)

colnames(cluster_membership_vel_w5) <- date_names_vel_w5
colnames(status_vel_w5) <- date_names_vel_w5
```

```{r}
# temporal clustering loop
set.seed(1234)

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # W5 displacement trajectory
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Rebase
  x <- sweep(x, 1, x[, 1], FUN = "-")
  
  # K-means on trajectory
  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  cluster_membership_vel_w5[, iter] <- km$cluster
  
  # Actual acquisition dates
  window_dates <- cadia_all_dates[start_idx:i]
  
  time_days <- as.numeric(
    window_dates - window_dates[1]
  )
  
  # Regression velocity for each point
  point_velocity <- apply(
    x,
    1,
    function(y) coef(lm(y ~ time_days))[2]
  ) * 365.25
  
  # Median velocity of each raw cluster
  cluster_velocity <- tapply(
    point_velocity,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  vel_medians_w5[iter, ] <-
    sort(cluster_velocity)
  
  # Fixed velocity status
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_velocity <= velocity_threshold,
    1,
    0
  )
  
  status_vel_w5[, iter] <-
    cluster_status[km$cluster]
  
  # Silhouette
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
    km$cluster,
    dist(x)
  )
  
  silhouette_vel_w5_old[iter] <-
    mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
}
```

### 6.1 Displacement Version: Temporal Clustering Loop

```{r}
# temporal clustering loop
for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Rebase each point within window
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  # Remove constant zero baseline
  x_db <- x[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  
  db <- dbscan(
    x_db,
    eps = eps_w5,
    minPts = minPts
  )
  
  dbscan_membership_w5[, iter] <-
    db$cluster
  
  dbscan_noise_w5[, iter] <-
    as.integer(db$cluster == 0)
}
```

## 7. Sliding Window w/ Velocity Version 2

### W3: Median Velocity

#### K = 2

```{r}
# setup
set.seed(1234)

k <- 2
window_size <- 3
velocity_threshold <- -30

n_pts_filtered <- nrow(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

n_iters_filtered <-
  n_dates_filtered - window_size + 1

iter_dates_filtered <-
  colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)[
    window_size:n_dates_filtered
  ]

cadia_all_dates <- as.Date(
  sub("^D_", "", colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)),
  format = "%Y%m%d"
)
```

```{r}
cluster_membership_vel_k2_w3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

cluster_velocity_vel_k2_w3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters_filtered,
  ncol = k
)

silhouette_vel_k2_w3_new <- numeric(
  n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_velocity_vel_k2_w3) <- c(
  "Lower_Cluster",
  "Higher_Cluster"
)

date_names <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)

colnames(cluster_membership_vel_k2_w3) <-
  date_names
```

```{r}
status_vel_k2_w3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(status_vel_k2_w3) <-
  date_names
```

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # Current W3 displacement observations
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # reset each point to 0 at start of window
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  # Actual acquisition dates
  window_dates <- cadia_all_dates[
    start_idx:i
  ]
  
  # Time relative to first acquisition
  time_days <- as.numeric(
    window_dates - window_dates[1]
  )
  
  # One regression velocity per point
  point_velocity <- apply(
    x,
    1,
    function(y) {
      coef(lm(y ~ time_days))[2]
    }
  )
  
  # mm/day -> mm/year
  point_velocity <- point_velocity * 365.25
  
  # Convert to matrix for K-means
  x_vel <- matrix(
    point_velocity,
    ncol = 1
  )
  
  # K-means DIRECTLY on velocity
  km <- kmeans(
    x_vel,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  # Store raw membership
  cluster_membership_vel_k2_w3[
    , iter
  ] <- km$cluster
  
  # Median velocity of each raw cluster
  cluster_velocity <- tapply(
    point_velocity,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_velocity <= velocity_threshold,
    1,
    0
  )
  
  status_vel_k2_w3[, iter] <-
    cluster_status[km$cluster]
  
  # Sort only for interpretation
  cluster_velocity_vel_k2_w3[
    iter,
  ] <- sort(cluster_velocity)
  
  # Silhouette based on velocity
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
    km$cluster,
    dist(x_vel)
  )
  
  silhouette_vel_k2_w3_new[iter] <-
    mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
}
```

```{r}
)
```

```{r}
threshold_1_vel_k3_w3 <- -50
threshold_2_vel_k3_w3 <- -75

status_vel_k3_w3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_vel_k3_w3
)

colnames(status_vel_k3_w3) <-
  date_names_vel_k3_w3
```

```{r}
# temporal clustering loop
set.seed(1234)

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # Current W3 displacement window
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Reset each point to 0 at start of window
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  # Dates for current window
  window_dates <- cadia_all_dates[
    start_idx:i
  ]
  
  # Days relative to first acquisition
  time_days <- as.numeric(
    window_dates - window_dates[1]
  )
  
  # One regression velocity per point
  point_velocity <- apply(
    x,
    1,
    function(y) {
      coef(lm(y ~ time_days))[2]
    }
  )
  
  # mm/day -> mm/year
  point_velocity <- point_velocity * 365.25
  
  # One-dimensional velocity input
  x_vel <- matrix(
    point_velocity,
    ncol = 1
  )
  
  # K-means DIRECTLY on velocity
  km <- kmeans(
    x_vel,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  # Store raw membership
  cluster_membership_vel_k3_w3[
    , iter
  ] <- km$cluster
  
  # Median velocity of each raw cluster
  cluster_velocity <- tapply(
    point_velocity,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # classify each raw K-means cluster
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_velocity <= threshold_2_vel_k3_w3,
    2,
    ifelse(
      cluster_velocity <= threshold_1_vel_k3_w3,
      1,
      0
    )
  )
  
  # each point inherits status of its cluster
  status_vel_k3_w3[, iter] <-
    cluster_status[km$cluster]
  
  # Sort only for examining/plotting
  cluster_velocity_vel_k3_w3[
    iter,
  ] <- sort(cluster_velocity)
  
  # Silhouette using velocity input
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
    km$cluster,
    dist(x_vel)
  )
  
  silhouette_vel_k3_w3_new[iter] <-
    mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
}
```

```{r}

  ]
```

```{r}
  "Higher_Cluster"
)

date_names_vel_k2_w5 <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_vel_k2_w5)
)

colnames(cluster_membership_vel_k2_w5) <-
  date_names_vel_k2_w5
```

```{r}
# status
status_vel_k2_w5 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_vel_k2_w5
)

colnames(status_vel_k2_w5) <-
  date_names_vel_k2_w5
```

```{r}
# temporal clustering loop
set.seed(1234)

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # Current W5 displacement window
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Rebase each point to 0 at start of window
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  # Actual acquisition dates
  window_dates <- cadia_all_dates[
    start_idx:i
  ]
  
  # Time relative to first acquisition
  time_days <- as.numeric(
    window_dates - window_dates[1]
  )
  
  # ONE regression velocity per point across W5
  point_velocity <- apply(
    x,
    1,
    function(y) {
      coef(lm(y ~ time_days))[2]
    }
  )
  
  # mm/day -> mm/year
  point_velocity <- point_velocity * 365.25
  
  # Velocity is now the clustering input
  x_vel <- matrix(
    point_velocity,
    ncol = 1
  )
  
  # K-means DIRECTLY on velocity
  km <- kmeans(
    x_vel,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  # Save raw membership
  cluster_membership_vel_k2_w5[
    , iter
  ] <- km$cluster
  
  # Median velocity of each cluster
  cluster_velocity <- tapply(
    point_velocity,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_velocity <= velocity_threshold_w5,
    1,
    0
  )
  
  status_vel_k2_w5[, iter] <-
    cluster_status[km$cluster]
  
  # Sort for interpretation
  cluster_velocity_vel_k2_w5[
    iter,
  ] <- sort(cluster_velocity)
  
  # Silhouette using VELOCITY space
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
    km$cluster,
    dist(x_vel)
  )
  
  silhouette_vel_k2_w5_new[iter] <-
    mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
}
```

```{r}
# temporal loop
set.seed(1234)

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {

  ]
  
  # Rebase first observation to 0

  # Actual acquisition dates
  window_dates <- cadia_all_dates[start_idx:i]
  
  # Time relative to first acquisition
  time_days <- as.numeric(
    window_dates - window_dates[1]
  )
  
  # One regression velocity per point
  point_velocity <- apply(
    x,
    1,
    function(y) {
      coef(lm(y ~ time_days))[2]
    }

  # mm/day -> mm/year

  # Velocity becomes K-means input

  )
  
  # K-means DIRECTLY on velocity

  )
  
  # Store raw membership
```

```{r}
lower_vel_k3_w5 <-
  cluster_velocity_vel_k3_w5[, "Lower_Cluster"]

threshold_pairs <- list(
  c(-30, -45),
  c(-30, -50),
  c(-35, -50),
  c(-35, -55),
  c(-40, -55)
)

threshold_check_k3_w5 <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    threshold_pairs,
    function(th) {
      
      status <- ifelse(
        lower_vel_k3_w5 <= th[2],
        2,
        ifelse(
          lower_vel_k3_w5 <= th[1],
          1,
          0
        )
      )
      
      data.frame(
        Threshold1 = th[1],
        Threshold2 = th[2],
        Status0_Windows = sum(status == 0),
        Status1_Windows = sum(status == 1),
        Status2_Windows = sum(status == 2)
      )
    }
  )
)

threshold_check_k3_w5
```

```{r}
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  # K-means on displacement trajectory
  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = 2,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  cluster_membership_peru_F_disp_k2_w3[, iter] <-
    km$cluster
  
  # Latest displacement in window
  latest_disp <- x[, ncol(x)]
  
  cluster_medians <- tapply(
    latest_disp,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_medians <= threshold_peru_F_disp,
    1,
    0
  )
  
  status_peru_F_disp_k2_w3[, iter] <-
    cluster_status[km$cluster]
  
  cluster_medians_peru_F_disp_k2_w3[iter, ] <-
    sort(cluster_medians)
  
  # Silhouette in displacement feature space
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
    km$cluster,
    dist(x)
  )
  
  silhouette_peru_F_disp_k2_w3[iter] <-
    mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
}
```

#### 9.1.2 Median velocity; k = 2

```{r}
# setup
set.seed(1234)

k <- 2
window_size <- 3
threshold_peru_F_vel <- -60

n_pts_peru_F <- nrow(peru_F_sliding)
n_dates_peru_F <- ncol(peru_F_sliding)

n_iters_peru_F <- n_dates_peru_F - window_size + 1

iter_dates_peru_F <- colnames(peru_F_sliding)[
  window_size:n_dates_peru_F
]

date_names_peru_F <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_peru_F)
)
```

```{r}
# matrices
cluster_membership_peru_F_vel_k2_w3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_peru_F,
  ncol = n_iters_peru_F
)

cluster_velocity_peru_F_vel_k2_w3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters_peru_F,
  ncol = 2
)

silhouette_peru_F_vel_k2_w3 <- numeric(
  n_iters_peru_F
)

colnames(cluster_membership_peru_F_vel_k2_w3) <-
  date_names_peru_F

colnames(cluster_velocity_peru_F_vel_k2_w3) <-
  c("Lower_Cluster", "Higher_Cluster")
```

```{r}
status_peru_F_vel_k2_w3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_peru_F,
  ncol = n_iters_peru_F
)

colnames(status_peru_F_vel_k2_w3) <-
  date_names_peru_F
```

```{r}
# temporal loop
set.seed(1234)

for (i in window_size:n_dates_peru_F) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # Extract W3 displacement window
  x <- peru_F_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Rebase each point to zero
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  # Actual acquisition dates
  window_dates <- peru_F_dates[start_idx:i]
  
  time_days <- as.numeric(
    window_dates - window_dates[1]
  )
  
  # One regression velocity per point
  point_velocity <- apply(
    x,
    1,
    function(y) {
      coef(lm(y ~ time_days))[2]
    }
  )
  
  # Convert mm/day -> mm/year
  point_velocity <- point_velocity * 365.25
  
  # K-means DIRECTLY on velocity
  x_vel <- matrix(
    point_velocity,
    ncol = 1
  )
  
  km <- kmeans(
    x_vel,
    centers = 2,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  # Store raw memberships
  cluster_membership_peru_F_vel_k2_w3[, iter] <-
    km$cluster
  
  # Median velocity of each cluster
  cluster_velocity <- tapply(
    point_velocity,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_velocity <= threshold_peru_F_vel,
    1,
    0
  )
  
  status_peru_F_vel_k2_w3[, iter] <-
    cluster_status[km$cluster]
  
  # Sorted only for examining the lower/higher groups
  cluster_velocity_peru_F_vel_k2_w3[iter, ] <-
    sort(cluster_velocity)
  
  # Silhouette in VELOCITY feature space
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
    km$cluster,
    dist(x_vel)
  )
  
  silhouette_peru_F_vel_k2_w3[iter] <-
    mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
}
```

```{r}
  cluster_velocity_peru_F_vel_k2_w3[, "Lower_Cluster"]

plot(

  type = "l",
  xlab = "Sliding window",
  ylab = "Median LOS velocity (mm/year)",

)
```


#### 9.1.3 DBSCAN

```{r}
library(dbscan)

window_size <- 3

n_pts_peru_F <- nrow(peru_F_sliding)
n_dates_peru_F <- ncol(peru_F_sliding)
n_iters_peru_F <- n_dates_peru_F - window_size + 1

iter_dates_peru_F <-
  colnames(peru_F_sliding)[window_size:n_dates_peru_F]

date_names_peru_F <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_peru_F)
)
```

```{r}
# inspect k-NN plot
i <- n_dates_peru_F
start_idx <- i - window_size + 1

x <- peru_F_sliding[, start_idx:i, drop = FALSE]

# Rebase
x <- sweep(x, 1, x[, 1], FUN = "-")

# Remove constant zero baseline
x_db <- x[, -1, drop = FALSE]

dbscan::kNNdistplot(
  x_db,
  k = 4
)

abline(h = 1, lty = 2)
```

```{r}
eps_values <- c(0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2)

for (e in eps_values) {
  
  db <- dbscan(
    x_db,
    eps = e,
    minPts = 5
  )
  
  cat(
    "\neps =", e,
    "\nclusters =", length(unique(db$cluster[db$cluster != 0])),
    "\nnoise =", sum(db$cluster == 0),
    "\nnoise % =", round(mean(db$cluster == 0) * 100, 1),
    "\n"
  )
}
```

```{r}
eps_peru_F <- 1.5
minPts <- 5
```

```{r}
dbscan_membership_peru_F_w3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_peru_F,
  ncol = n_iters_peru_F
)

colnames(dbscan_membership_peru_F_w3) <-
  date_names_peru_F

noise_count_peru_F <- numeric(n_iters_peru_F)
n_clusters_peru_F <- numeric(n_iters_peru_F)
```

```{r}
for (i in window_size:n_dates_peru_F) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  x <- peru_F_sliding[, start_idx:i, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Rebase
  x <- sweep(x, 1, x[, 1], FUN = "-")
  
  # Remove constant baseline
  x_db <- x[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  
  db <- dbscan::dbscan(
    x_db,
    eps = eps_peru_F,
    minPts = minPts
  )
  
  dbscan_membership_peru_F_w3[, iter] <-
    db$cluster
  
  noise_count_peru_F[iter] <-
    sum(db$cluster == 0)
  
  n_clusters_peru_F[iter] <-
    length(unique(db$cluster[db$cluster != 0]))
}
```

#### 9.2.2 Median velocity; k = 2

```{r}
# setup
set.seed(1234)

k <- 2
window_size <- 3
threshold_peru_U_vel <- -60

n_pts_peru_U <- nrow(peru_U_sliding)
n_dates_peru_U <- ncol(peru_U_sliding)
n_iters_peru_U <- n_dates_peru_U - window_size + 1

iter_dates_peru_U <-
  colnames(peru_U_sliding)[window_size:n_dates_peru_U]

date_names_peru_U <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_peru_U)
)
```

```{r}
# matrices
cluster_membership_peru_U_vel_k2_w3 <- matrix(
  NA, nrow = n_pts_peru_U, ncol = n_iters_peru_U
)

cluster_velocity_peru_U_vel_k2_w3 <- matrix(
  NA, nrow = n_iters_peru_U, ncol = 2
)

silhouette_peru_U_vel_k2_w3 <- numeric(n_iters_peru_U)

colnames(cluster_membership_peru_U_vel_k2_w3) <-
  date_names_peru_U

colnames(cluster_velocity_peru_U_vel_k2_w3) <-
  c("Lower_Cluster", "Higher_Cluster")
```

```{r}
status_peru_U_vel_k2_w3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_peru_U,
  ncol = n_iters_peru_U
)

colnames(status_peru_U_vel_k2_w3) <-
  date_names_peru_U
```

```{r}
# temporal loop
set.seed(1234)

for (i in window_size:n_dates_peru_U) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # W3 displacement window
  x <- peru_U_sliding[, start_idx:i, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Rebase first date to zero
  x <- sweep(x, 1, x[, 1], FUN = "-")
  
  # Actual dates
  window_dates <- peru_U_dates[start_idx:i]
  time_days <- as.numeric(window_dates - window_dates[1])
  
  # One velocity per point over the window
  point_velocity <- apply(
    x,
    1,
    function(y) coef(lm(y ~ time_days))[2]
  ) * 365.25
  
  # K-means DIRECTLY on velocity
  x_vel <- matrix(point_velocity, ncol = 1)
  
  km <- kmeans(
    x_vel,
    centers = 2,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  # Membership
  cluster_membership_peru_U_vel_k2_w3[, iter] <-
    km$cluster
  
  # Median velocity of each cluster
  cluster_velocity <- tapply(
    point_velocity,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_velocity <= threshold_peru_U_vel,
    1,
    0
  )
  
  status_peru_U_vel_k2_w3[, iter] <-
    cluster_status[km$cluster]
  
  cluster_velocity_peru_U_vel_k2_w3[iter, ] <-
    sort(cluster_velocity)
  
  # Silhouette in velocity space
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
    km$cluster,
    dist(x_vel)
  )
  
  silhouette_peru_U_vel_k2_w3[iter] <-
    mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
}
```

```{r}
summary(cluster_velocity_peru_U_vel_k2_w3)

summary(silhouette_peru_U_vel_k2_w3)
mean(silhouette_peru_U_vel_k2_w3)

lower_vel_peru_U <-
  cluster_velocity_peru_U_vel_k2_w3[, "Lower_Cluster"]

plot(
  lower_vel_peru_U,
  type = "l",
  xlab = "Sliding window",
  ylab = "Median LOS velocity (mm/year)",
  main = "Peru Unfailed W3 k=2 - Lower velocity cluster"
)

abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
```

```{r}
# threshold checking
lower_vel_peru_U <-
  cluster_velocity_peru_U_vel_k2_w3[, "Lower_Cluster"]

thresholds <- c(-30, -40, -50, -60, -70, -80, -100)

threshold_check_peru_U_vel <- data.frame(
  Threshold = thresholds,
  WindowsBelow = sapply(
    thresholds,
    function(th) {
      sum(lower_vel_peru_U <= th, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  )
)

threshold_check_peru_U_vel
```

#### 9.2.3 DBSCAN

```{r}
window_size <- 3

n_pts_peru_U <- nrow(peru_U_sliding)
n_dates_peru_U <- ncol(peru_U_sliding)
n_iters_peru_U <- n_dates_peru_U - window_size + 1

iter_dates_peru_U <-
  colnames(peru_U_sliding)[window_size:n_dates_peru_U]

date_names_peru_U <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_peru_U)
)
```

```{r}
i <- n_dates_peru_U
start_idx <- i - window_size + 1

x <- peru_U_sliding[, start_idx:i, drop = FALSE]

# Rebase first observation to zero
x <- sweep(x, 1, x[, 1], FUN = "-")

# Remove zero baseline column
x_db <- x[, -1, drop = FALSE]

dbscan::kNNdistplot(
  x_db,
  k = 4
)

abline(h = 1.5, lty = 2)
```

```{r}
eps_values <- c(0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2)

for (e in eps_values) {
  
  db <- dbscan::dbscan(
    x_db,
    eps = e,
    minPts = 5
  )
  
  cat(
    "\neps =", e,
    "\nclusters =", length(unique(db$cluster[db$cluster != 0])),
    "\nnoise =", sum(db$cluster == 0),
    "\nnoise % =", round(mean(db$cluster == 0) * 100, 1),
    "\n"
  )
}
```

```{r}
eps_peru_U <- 1.5
minPts <- 5
```

```{r}
dbscan_membership_peru_U_w3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_peru_U,
  ncol = n_iters_peru_U
)

colnames(dbscan_membership_peru_U_w3) <-
  date_names_peru_U

noise_count_peru_U <- numeric(n_iters_peru_U)
n_clusters_peru_U <- numeric(n_iters_peru_U)
```

```{r}
# temporal loop
for (i in window_size:n_dates_peru_U) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  x <- peru_U_sliding[, start_idx:i, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Rebase first observation to zero
  x <- sweep(x, 1, x[, 1], FUN = "-")
  
  # Remove constant baseline
  x_db <- x[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  
  db <- dbscan::dbscan(
    x_db,
    eps = eps_peru_U,
    minPts = minPts
  )
  
  dbscan_membership_peru_U_w3[, iter] <- db$cluster
  
  noise_count_peru_U[iter] <-
    sum(db$cluster == 0)
  
  n_clusters_peru_U[iter] <-
    length(unique(db$cluster[db$cluster != 0]))
}
```

```{r}
plot_flagged_pct <- function(status_matrix, dates, title) {

  flagged_pct <- colMeans(status_matrix == 1) * 100

  plot(
    dates,
    flagged_pct,
    type = "l",
    ylim = c(0, 100),
    xlab = "Date",
    ylab = "Flagged points (%)",
    main = title
  )

  return(flagged_pct)
}
```


```{r}
plot_status_pct_k3 <- function(status_matrix, dates, title) {

  status_pct <- sapply(
    0:2,
    function(s) colMeans(status_matrix == s) * 100
  )

  matplot(
    dates,
    status_pct,
    type = "l",
    lty = 1,
    ylim = c(0, 100),
    xlab = "Date",
    ylab = "Points (%)",
    main = title
  )

  legend(
    "right",
    legend = c("Status 0", "Status 1", "Status 2"),
    lty = 1
  )

  return(status_pct)
}
```
